_readme: Original hotel photography referenced in the existing WordPress export (see docs/CONTENT-SOURCES.md). `key` is the local file name stem under src/assets/photos/ and is what components refer to. Files are committed in the repository, so `npm run fetch:images` is only needed to re-download them. Nothing is hotlinked at runtime.

candidates._readme: Possible better lead images for the room categories, taken from the existing room pages and gallery export. They have NOT been viewed (this environment cannot download them). Run `npm run fetch:candidates` to download them to src/assets/candidates/ (git-ignored) and build a contact sheet at docs/room-photo-candidates.jpg for review. Evidence that a photo is the hotel's own category picture comes from the image sitemap, which shows junior14, executive7, panoramic2 (Summer Deal) and deluxe5, junior2 (Pchum Ben) as the thumbnails on its offers pages. The `venues` group holds Le Moon candidates for the Rooftop & Dining section. Sombok has none: the exports reference only the portrait already in use.
